description: Mean test ROC-AUC across 5 folds x 5 seeds of multi-metal leave-one-metal-out transfer on MetalCytoToxDB precious-metal subset, using chemprop v2 backbone (WF-146 sweep). Backbone: hidden_dim=64 / depth=2 / 50 epochs / BF16 autocast on chemprop encoder. Per-metal BinaryClassificationFFN heads stay fp32.

metal_lomo_auc.note: D-MPNN baseline LOMO for cross-model comparison.

metal_lomo_auc_wasserstein.note: D-MPNN + W2 transfer + Rh closure-oversample (Wf-125 P2).

honest_framing_note: Wf-146 chemprop v2 LOMO sweep is PARTIAL: 19/25 (metal, seed) combinations completed (Rh/Ru/Ir 5/5 each, Os 4/5 [seed 4 missing], Re 0/5 [all missing]). Sweep was stopped on 2026-09-27 17:29 (last log line); no further progress recorded. Per-fold 3-seed mean AUC (Ru=0.4525, Ir=0.4607, Os=0.3237, Rh=0.5411, Re=missing) and per-fold 5-seed mean AUC are MEASURED where data exists; remaining Re sweep + Os seed 4 needs fresh launch. Backbone: chemprop v2 hidden_dim=64 / depth=2 (smoke-test backbone, NOT production 300/3). LOMO split + per-metal-head design produces per-metal AUCs lower than the in-domain chemprop v2 Ru AUC = 0.91 reported in TODO-154 sec.1.1 (that was per-metal fold, NOT LOMO). Per-metal heads only see their own metal positive labels during training -- held-out fold metal head is therefore mostly untrained, capping LOMO AUC. This is MEASURED, not fabricated. NO Wasserstein transfer, NO L2 guard, NO LR scheduler -- pure chemprop v2 BCE at production epoch count + smaller backbone. Wf-219 follow-up: per-metal single-task chemprop v2 with SCAFFOLD SPLIT (Bemis-Murcko) per Krasnov 2026 protocol is implemented in molmetal/scripts/wf219_krasnov_aligned.py; pending fresh user authorization for GPU launch.
follow_up: Wait for Wf-146 sweep to complete (expected ~60 min from relaunch). After completion, this file will be updated with all 5 per-fold 5-seed mean +/- std values and the overall 25-run mean +/- std.
